lead.description: repeated observations of the same units, so each record has both a unit and a time

self_checks.title: Balanced changes
self_checks.prompt: Three units change by +2, 0, and +3. What is the mean change, and how does it compare with a rise in the cross-sectional mean from 10/3 to 5?
self_checks.answer: The mean change is 5/3, and the wave means differ by 5 - 10/3 = 5/3.

self_checks.title: A missing second wave
self_checks.prompt: Changes of +2 and 0 are observed, while the wave means that can be computed are 10/3 and 9/2. What are the mean of the observed changes and the difference of the wave means?
self_checks.answer: The mean of the observed changes is 1. The difference of the wave means is 7/6.

self_checks.title: Two complete units
self_checks.prompt: One unit moves from 1 to 4 and another stays at 6. What is the mean change?
self_checks.answer: The mean change is 1.5, and the wave means differ by the same 1.5.

overview_sentence: [Panel data](articles/panel-data.qmd) are repeated observations of the same units over time.
